pull_request.body:
## Goal

Promote the existing future Track M Agent Session / Delegation boundary into the next bounded CAP product mechanism, while stopping reviewer-specific architecture from becoming the general agent runtime.

## BASE

Accepted `main`: `90a8e16e6a1badecd3315968339ca691634b7ee4`.

## Stage Research

`project-context/AGENT_SESSION_DELEGATION_REENTRY.md` records the fresh Stage Research / source-code research decision: **NARROW**.

Selected first scope:

```text
one manager
 -> one fresh read-only worker
 -> one bounded delegation identity
 -> one initial delivery
 -> one correlated structured terminal result
 -> durable local closure
```

The first physical adapter targets non-personalized ChatGPT Temporary Chat. The generic core remains provider-neutral. Reviewer methodology, repository-context retrieval, code graphs, reviewer benchmarks and reviewer learning remain outside generic lifecycle ownership.

## Implemented L1 — generic delegation state

The PR now contains the bounded generic lifecycle foundation:

- deterministic provider-independent delegation identity;
- immutable private genesis and private `run_id` capability;
- separate durable `delivery_id`;
- accepted OS-backed local serialization and crash-safe checkpoint replacement;
- one-shot durable launch-attempt claim before physical launch;
- exact child/session binding;
- one delivery claim under contention;
- `prepared | claimed | unknown | delivered` delivery lifecycle;
- no blind re-Send from `claimed`, `unknown` or `delivered`;
- fresh-evidence `unknown -> delivered` reconciliation for the same delivery only;
- one generic `WORKER_RESULT_V1` terminal result with `COMPLETED | ABSTAIN | ERROR`;
- exact delegation/delivery/worker/contract correlation and adapter-computed payload SHA-256;
- corrupt, incomplete, foreign and sibling-temp residue state fails closed.

## Implemented L2 candidate — `chatgpt-temporary`

A narrow provider adapter now exists above the generic state machine:

```text
durable launch-attempt
 -> one fresh Temporary Chat child
 -> positive fresh/non-personalized/no-plugin qualification
 -> extension-origin IndexedDB unique browser delivery claim
 -> project-local durable delivery claim
 -> one Send authority
 -> delivered | unknown observation
 -> same-delivery reconciliation only
 -> exact generic result capture
 -> durable terminal closure
```

Important L2 boundaries:

- the MV3 extension has no GitHub, filesystem, `nativeMessaging`, cookies, downloads, management or general network authority;
- its only host permission is the pinned loopback controller at `127.0.0.1:3078`;
- the private durable `run_id` stays out of the model prompt and HTTP query and is carried only in the URL fragment / authenticated loopback path;
- duplicate tabs cannot obtain a second Send claim;
- a controller restart may finish the already-committed same-tab browser claim only while durable delivery state is still `prepared`; `claimed | unknown | delivered` remain monitor-only;
- ambiguous Send never creates a re-Send path;
- exact runtime provenance is checked for any already-bound worker session, not only recorded terminal results;
- actual executing MV3 generation is bound by `execution_generation`, carried by both content context and service worker, and checked by the controller in addition to runtime asset hashes;
- running extension resources are SHA-256 attested against exact-head expected bytes before Send authority and re-attested before terminal result capture;
- terminal readback is accepted only when durable worker-session runtime provenance matches the current exact expected runtime attestation;
- initial and recovered monitor-only paths both explicitly arm the post-delivery UI guard;
- after delivery, launch capability/query state and the bound composer must remain disarmed continuously before result capture can complete;
- any observed draft restoration or synchronous dirty-state observation resets the clean-window epoch and requires a new uninterrupted 8-second clean interval plus a new ACK;
- structured result capture synchronously rechecks the current launch URL and composer state rather than trusting periodic polling state;
- physical qualification reports PASS only for a correlated terminal `COMPLETED` result, never for `ABSTAIN` or `ERROR`;
- the physical launcher performs clean exact-head source-provenance checks before and after the run.

## Fresh-review findings resolved

Earlier fresh ordinary-ChatGPT reviews on superseded heads reported concrete defects. All were independently reproduced/confirmed before fixes were made.

The superseded `29ff9607...` review identified:

1. recorded terminal-result reuse across different HEADs under the same custom durable delegation identity;
2. result capture trusting a stale `postDeliveryUiDisarmed=true` cache between UI polls.

The superseded `93b727d7...` review then identified four further cases:

1. cross-HEAD `delivered/open` sessions could still reach a new controller before terminal-result recording;
2. asset fetch attestation did not prove which MV3 content/service-worker generation was actually executing;
3. reload/resume recovery could run without re-arming the post-delivery UI guard;
4. a synchronous dirty composer observation could be followed by an immediate clean state without forcing a new full 8-second uninterrupted clean interval.

Current regression coverage now requires:

- runtime provenance compatibility for any bound worker session before resumed controller authority;
- stale cross-HEAD `delivered/open` sessions to fail closed without recording a new result;
- deterministic `execution_generation` derived from the current runtime asset set;
- exact generation agreement across content script, service worker, controller and resume-intent paths;
- explicit post-delivery guard arming on both initial and recovered paths;
- result capture to fail closed if the guard is not armed;
- any synchronous dirty observation to reset the guard epoch/stability timer;
- a new uninterrupted 8-second clean window and ACK before capture can become eligible again.

Any semantic review or physical PASS for `29ff9607...` or `93b727d7...` is superseded.

## Exact-head hosted gate

Frozen physical/review head:

`bfe8986168db4badde48d2b303877659223aecc8`

All required hosted workflows completed successfully on this exact head:

- `ci`;
- CodeQL Security;
- Secret History Scan;
- Stage 26.3A Six-Tool Semantic Acceptance;
- Semantic Projection Acceptance;
- Direct Semantic Tunnel Acceptance;
- Stage 25.1 Vision Runtime Acceptance;
- Stage 26.3B Windows Application L3 Acceptance.

Any material source change after this freeze invalidates the exact-head review and affected physical evidence.

## Exact-head physical evidence — stale executing generation rejected

Before installing the current extension generation, the target Windows machine intentionally kept the older `93b727d...` extension executing while the controller expected current HEAD `bfe89861...`.

Observed evidence:

```text
CAP_AGENT_SESSION_EXACT_HEAD=bfe8986168db4badde48d2b303877659223aecc8
CAP_AGENT_SESSION_EXECUTION_GENERATION=0a38f904cb9c6a4db1e752245af4356e9bd25b04babfde08458a341f9a555b90
ADAPTER_LOADED_COUNT=1
BROWSER_CLAIM_FAILED_COUNT=1
SEND_CLICK_COUNT=0
RESULT_FILE_EXISTS=False
CLAIM_FAILURE_REASON=local-authority-failed:controller-409:runtime attestation keys mismatch: missing=['execution_generation'] unexpected=none
STALE_EXECUTING_EXTENSION_GENERATION=REJECTED
STALE_EXTENSION_SEND_COUNT=0
CAP_AGENT_SESSION_STALE_GENERATION_NEGATIVE=PASS
```

This physically proves that a stale executing content/service-worker generation does not gain Send authority merely because newer files exist on disk.

## Exact-head physical L3 — PASS

Target-Windows / ordinary-Plus physical qualification then ran with the exact current extension generation and Windows checkout bytes.

Current runtime generation:

```text
execution_generation=0a38f904cb9c6a4db1e752245af4356e9bd25b04babfde08458a341f9a555b90
```

Exact Windows runtime SHA-256 values used by both the worktree/controller and the manually loaded extension:

```text

execution_generation.js=e9cdd016b7a219efd2da5f82d2e657fe5f9a2417f5573c05e4433fa1f58e9d76
policy.js=59304eca982ede9cf6dffe310d67315e2c3c96a2a7a30d0be324fea7c0e5cee5
background.js=f5016abf1370412e4c19bfde7153c1d9da510c6b9238b1b9a300f0ac359002c9
content.js=0ba18b6cd07d1aca970bb33bf49c8db1fc1b20a65ddc3a058858b4855d0e181d
```

Observed correlated result:

```text
task_sha256=5e838b3670866fb3dafc6b3111498dfba24b57c26fbc5bb693e2b783b5b18495
delegation_id=270245b499da0abdacaac2e746e5ff0ab22073c2c9f827004cac71f90f91d08f
delivery_id=c8697a0be1f4804d8e7bbf04577c82e4f81274288c0dc51f9c8f582eca0ebff5
result_sha256=e5defcbee00b6b73d71f75e6c482d0adaa12090ebacda02f0d8d329ce6ab8a47
```

Physical assertions passed:

```text

FIRST_RESULT_STATUS=COMPLETED
ADAPTER_LOADED_COUNT=1
SEND_COUNT=1
BROWSER_CLAIM_COUNT=1
DELIVERY_VISIBLE_TOTAL=2

SECOND_RESULT_STATUS=COMPLETED

STALE_OLD_EXECUTION_GENERATION_NEGATIVE=PASS
CURRENT_EXECUTION_GENERATION=0a38f904cb9c6a4db1e752245af4356e9bd25b04babfde08458a341f9a555b90
CAP_AGENT_SESSION_L3_BFE89861_WINDOWS=PASS
```

The operator-provided final screenshot also shows the Temporary Chat composer visually empty after completion, matching controller-side cleanup evidence.

One earlier manual packaging attempt used GitHub LF bytes rather than Windows checkout CRLF bytes and was correctly rejected by runtime attestation at `manifest.json` before Send. That packaging attempt is negative evidence only and is not part of the accepted PASS.

The accepted exact-head path now proves:

```text
stale executing MV3 generation
 -> adapter loads
 -> execution generation missing/mismatched
 -> controller fails closed
 -> zero Send

exact Windows current source/runtime generation
 -> one fresh non-personalized Temporary Chat child
 -> exact executing-generation + runtime-asset attestation
 -> one bound task delivery / one Send
 -> durable delivered observation
 -> launch URL + bound composer disarmed
 -> uninterrupted clean window + ACK
 -> synchronous current UI recheck at capture
 -> correlated COMPLETED WORKER_RESULT_V1
 -> source/runtime provenance revalidated
 -> same-head restart terminal-readback without second child or second Send
```

## Preserved boundaries

- ordinary ChatGPT remains the only current general planner;
- Control Plane / WorkingState / Verification Kernel / Finish Gate remain project-owned authority;
- exactly six public tools remain unchanged;
- no generic scheduler/event bus;
- no same-task automatic parent wake/resampling;
- no nested/fan-out workers;
- no mutating child worker;
- no project/worktree/environment creation;
- existing accepted independent-review procedures remain intact until a separately proven generic reviewer-consumer migration is safe.

## Prior experimental work

PR #145 and PR #138 remain experiment evidence only and must not be merged as the generic runtime. Their useful fresh-chat/one-Send observations were adapted behind the generic delegation boundary; reviewer-specific experiment semantics were not carried into `WORKER_RESULT_V1`.

## Acceptance remaining

This PR remains Draft / not merge-ready. Remaining gates:

1. mandatory fresh ordinary-ChatGPT exact-head semantic review under the BASE review policy for BASE `90a8e16e6a1badecd3315968339ca691634b7ee4` and HEAD `bfe8986168db4badde48d2b303877659223aecc8`;
2. address only findings that survive independent validation; any material source fix invalidates the exact-head review and affected physical evidence;
3. re-resolve final BASE/HEAD, hosted CI and physical evidence against the reviewed refs;
4. merge when all frozen gates remain current.
